vetSays.line: 🛡️ Nolan, Raul, Saul and Sam met them at the door — 4 put down. Nolan, Raul, Sam are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Raj — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Raj chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
🛡️ Saul, Valentina, Raj and Priya met them at the door — 4 put down. Saul, Valentina, Raj, Priya are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sam just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Saul just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nolan, Raul, Saul and Raj met them at the door — 4 put down. Nolan, Raul, Saul, Raj are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stan just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stan just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🛡️ Sofia met them at the door — 1 put down.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mia just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mia just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sofia and Mia met them at the door — 2 put down. Sofia is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mia just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mia met them at the door — 1 put down. Mia is hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mia just put down The Algorithm... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mia and Brian met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Brian is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mia just put down The Rerun... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Brian just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
